mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND CODE = X.CLAIM_TYPE) AS CLAIM_TEXT, ROUND(X.DATE_1,0) AS DATE_1, ROUND(X.DATE_2,0) AS DATE_2, ROUND(X.DATE_3,0) AS DATE_3, ROUND(X.DATE_4,0) AS DATE_4, ROUND(X.DATE_5,0) AS DATE_5, ROUND(X.DATE_6,0) AS DATE_6, ROUND(X.DATE_7,0) AS DATE_7, ROUND(X.DATE_8,0) AS DATE_8, ROUND(X.DATE_9,0) AS DATE_9, ROUND(X.DATE_10,0) AS DATE_10, ROUND(X.DATE_11,0) AS DATE_11, ROUND(X.DATE_12,0) AS DATE_12, X.CLAIM_TYPE FROM ( SELECT A.CLAIM_TYPE, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),01,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_1, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),02,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_2, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),03,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_3, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),04,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_4, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),05,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_5, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),06,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_6, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),07,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_7, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),08,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_8, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),09,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_9, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),10,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_10, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),11,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_11, NVL(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),5,2),12,ROUND(A.DF_DATE-A.CD_DATE,0))),0)/COUNT(A.CD_DATE) AS DATE_12 FROM KEPAVCDT A , (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND TEXT3 = 'C') B WHERE TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') LIKE #{st_year} || '%' AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'FB' AND A.CLAIM_TYPE = B.CODE GROUP BY A.CLAIM_TYPE ) X ORDER BY X.CLAIM_TYPE
